acquire:blurite.comment: Rune kit plus six lobsters for the ice-warrior corridor. Nothing in this recipe eats them: the walk guard holds a prayer only (docs/api/script.md:893-894), so they are the operator's food after a Stop, not an automatic sustain. Skipped once underground so a restart never tries to walk back to a bank through the zones.

A returned swing would cancel the walk (AIO dungeon.ts:66-67 lesson); the walks rely on the best-effort walk guard instead (see ice-walk-4), so at Base40 the crossings are unprotected and nothing hits back.

Bars from the bank, else banked ore smelted at Falador. Skipped once the bank is known to hold neither bars nor ore and no ore is held, so the GAP step below is the one that fails and the parked Step field names the gap.

GAP: mining iron ore is the gather family, which is not on release 6ba83abfc. Rimmington iron rocks (ironrock1/ironrock2) are at 2968-2971,3237-3242 and 2981-2982,3233-3234 (maps/m46_50.jm2:5666-6201). Reached only when iron-bars above is skipped because neither bars nor ore are banked or held; it fails after 10 ticks with 'wait exhausted' and, as a top-level step, the parked Step field shows this id. The bot parks wherever it stands (usually the bank it just checked). Replace with the mining step when gather lands.
Safe route first: blurite the operator banked. Only when none is banked does the dungeon recipe below run.

Walks into the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon to the nearest blurite rock. The recipe ends there (gather gap), so it settles on arrival and is skipped once beside the rock; the GAP step below is then the one that fails, so the parked Step field names the gap. When gather lands, put the mining step after ice-walk-5 and return both skip_if and settle to has_item blurite_ore.

GAP: mining the blurite rock (bluriterock, op Mine, Mining 10; skill_mining/configs/rocks.loc:364-377, mine.dbrow:143-152) is the gather family, which is not on release 6ba83abfc. Blurite ore has no other source in the content. Reached once the blurite recipe above has brought the bot beside the rock; it fails after 10 ticks with 'wait exhausted' and, as a top-level step, the parked Step field shows this id. Stop the run as soon as the bot stands beside the rock: it is unprotected at Base40 (see ice-walk-4), nothing eats, and the ice warriors keep attacking a parked bot.
